The note is incorrect: adhesive wound closure strips are thin adhesive-backed strips applied to the skin surface, not thick rubberised bands stitched into the skin, and they typically stay on for about 5–10 days rather than several weeks. To remove them, peel slowly at a low angle while supporting the skin, and use rubbing alcohol or adhesive remover for stubborn residue. Clean the area afterward to remove leftover adhesive.
CONFIDENCE: 90
